chunks: From him, from al-Naḍr, from Mūsā ibn Bakr, from al-Fuḍayl, who said:
I asked him about forgetfulness, and he said: In Salat al-Maghrib, if you do not retain certainty between the three and the four, then repeat your prayer.

key_terms.الثَّلَاثَ: three units of prayer under consideration in the doubt
key_terms.السَّهْوِ: forgetfulness or inadvertent doubt occurring during prayer
key_terms.الْأَرْبَعِ: four units of prayer, the mistaken excess under doubt
key_terms.صَلَاةِ الْمَغْرِبِ: the Maghrib prayer, the sunset salat consisting of three rak'ahs

ai.seo_question: What should someone do if they doubt the rak'ahs in Salat al-Maghrib?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning forgetfulness in Salat al-Maghrib. It states that if a person cannot preserve certainty regarding whether they have prayed three or four rak'ahs, they must repeat the prayer.
